change: Omi now offers to connect an integration when you open an app it works with — Gmail, Google Calendar, Apple Notes, Notion, Obsidian, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, X, or your local files — with what the integration would do for you and what Omi would read; every connector's sheet now shows the same 'What you get' detail, and you can turn the suggestions off or reset them in Settings → Notifications
